description: How in-game menus and navigation work.
prompt_template:
Given this style guide:
{style_guide}
And this gameplay style:
{prior_picks.gameplay_style}

Generate {count} menu options covering:
- Layout: vertical_list | horizontal_strip | grid | radial | paged_cards | parallax_scroll
- Selection input: dpad | crank | both
- Visual treatment: text_only | icon_plus_text | image_cards | sprite_sheets
- Confirm pattern: A_to_select | A_held | A_then_confirm | dpad_right_to_advance
- uses_gridview: true if layout=grid (triggers playdate.ui.gridview)
- uses_crank: true if selection_input includes crank (requires CoreLibs/ui/crankIndicator check)
- nine_slice_panel: true if menu has a styled background panel

Return a JSON array of exactly {count} options matching option_schema.
refinement_prompt: Revise the menu option below per the user feedback. Keep uses_gridview/uses_crank/nine_slice_panel flags consistent with layout + selection_input.

option_schema.name: string
option_schema.layout: enum: vertical_list | horizontal_strip | grid | radial | paged_cards | parallax_scroll
